LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_DivineSword.nodes.0.d: Retains original critical value, direct damage and random critical multiplier. Branches count only your ordinary hits that actually damage enemies; abilities, friendly and secondary hits do not count. Progression stays with the item.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_DivineSword.nodes.1.d: Two ordinary critical hits on the same enemy within 4 seconds add 3 base slash damage to the second hit, once per 8 seconds. A critical hit on another enemy restarts the count. Noncritical hits neither count nor extend the window. Base rewards: damage 75.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_DivineSword.nodes.2.d: An ordinary noncritical hit that damages an enemy stores one edge for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary critical hit consumes it for 2 base slash damage. Store at most one; you may switch targets. Noncritical hits cannot spend it. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_DivineSword.nodes.3.d: After Relentless Edge deals actual bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Cannot restore missing parts or permanent scars. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_DivineSword.nodes.4.d: After Relentless Edge deals actual bonus damage, leave a light burst at the impact cell. After 0.75 seconds, deal 25 base damage each to up to two enemies within 2 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. The cell is fixed and does not follow enemies. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_DivineSword.nodes.5.d: After Tempered Edge deals actual bonus damage, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Never shields you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_DivineSword.nodes.6.d: After Tempered Edge deals actual bonus damage, deal 25 base damage to one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Never hits the original victim again. Base rewards: damage 25.
